Company Description 
 Principal33 is a fast-growing European IT company that helps organizations design and deliver high-quality digital solutions across software engineering, digital transformation, data, AI, and cloud services. With offices in Spain, Germany, and three locations in Romania, principal33 combines senior expertise with a strong regional presence to create measurable business impact. The company partners with clients to modernize technology, optimize processes, and unlock the value of data. Team members have the opportunity to work on diverse international projects and stay at the forefront of digital innovation. Applicants can expect a collaborative environment focused on professional growth and long-term client relationships.
Your mission The Domain Area operateM2C is responsible for the operation and further development of the new Meter2Cash system landscape within the group’s network division.
 Within the overall context of the Domain Area, the Domain Data & Analytics develops all reporting relevant to the Meter2Cash processes in order to provide various stakeholders (e.g., internal group clients, external market partners, regulatory authorities, etc.) with information and insights.
 The assignment is focused on the development, enhancement, and operation of data models in SAP BW/4HANA.
 The functional context is within the area of market communication and master data reporting.
Your profile Responsibilities: 
 Translation of provided business requirements in the context of case clarification analyses into a technical solution design, taking into account the development standards defined by the client.
 Technical definition, documentation, and presentation (for approval) of data models in the Business Warehouse in line with the defined business requirements 
 Implementation of data models for BDO market communication & master data reporting based on relevant source systems (SAP MaCo Cloud, SAP S/4 Utilities, CSV data sources), including the creation of technical objects and coding in SAP BW/4HANA using ABAP and SQL 
 Implementation aligned with the prioritization of the Product Owner, based on planned top initiatives, harmonized business requirements, and quality assurance measures to ensure operational stability 
 Clarifications with stakeholders, including identification of logical inconsistencies and execution of data cleansing activities 
 Framework Conditions: 
 Technologies: SAP BW/4HANA, S/4 Utilities, HANA SQL, ABAP, SAC 
 Source systems: SAP MaCo Cloud, SAP S/4 Utilities, CSV data sources 
 Documentation & standards: Fully provided by the client, 
 Working model: Remote 
 Language: German (mandatory for business communication) 
 Professional Skills: 
 VISL (Level 4) 
 INAN (Level 5) 
 DTAN (Level 4) 
 DESN (Level 5) 
 BUAN (Level 4) 
 CNSL (Level 5) 
 Soft Skills: 
 Strong communication skills 
 High degree of personal responsibility and ownership 
 Persuasiveness 
 Experience as a developer in an agile project environment 
 Team player mindset 
 Reliable and accountable in both words and actions
